exit_decision: The first lithium benchmark has sufficient semantic diversity to stop adding trajectories for benchmark count and move the main path to a non-lithium falsification pilot.
exit_reason: The lithium benchmark has already forced and runtime-proven materially different primitives: project state and qualification/ramp, unknown-onset Reality with independent observation and known-time, immutable Judgment vintages with rationale, explicit non-relation when revision identity is not clean, contract/inventory/accounting semantics, authoritative redistribution plus materialized evidence transport, and a cross-project counterexample showing that nameplate capacity cannot be converted to effective supply by a universal delay or haircut rule. Additional lithium trajectories now have lower architecture-falsification value than a second industry.

proven_trajectories.proof: state-as-of Reality, qualification/ramp semantics and no-lookahead replay
two contemporaneous cognition vintages, source-backed rationale, no manufactured REVISES relation and no manufactured Outcome
contract-vintage pricing, cost-pass-through lag, inventory/accounting semantics, source-backed commitment rationale and typed replay without synthetic spot-spread margin
delayed and timely counterexamples can coexist without a universal project-delay prior

generated_execution_drive.role: generated execution relay only; no externally acquired source bytes

evt005_fmc_counterexample.semantic_result: FMC provides the required timely/on-plan counterexample: the archived filing and issuer results support added China lithium-hydroxide capacity, completion ahead of schedule, key-customer qualification, commercial production/sales state and subsequent reported volume contribution. This prevents the benchmark from learning a failure-only rule from delayed projects.
evt005_fmc_counterexample.parser_integrity_result: The final Evidence gate stayed strict. PDF page text preserved line breaks and canonical HTML visible text preserved deterministic spacing, so the spec was corrected to parser-reproducible claim-scoped excerpts rather than weakening substring matching.

normal_ci.storage_boundary_tests: split transport is CI-green: externally acquired raw source packs use GitHub Release; Longcycle-generated replay/execution/runtime state uses Google Drive; live PostgreSQL is not transported as session state

reuse_policy: Lithium remains a regression/reference benchmark and its sealed evidence/replay assets remain available on demand, but it is no longer the active research cursor. Re-enter only when a later cross-industry defect requires a lithium regression check or new user/product need justifies it.

next_industry.bounded_scope: antibody drug conjugates (ADC), China-linked global development and business development
next_industry.anti_contamination_rule: Start a clean research vintage for formal ADC blind recall. The 2026 freshness check used to choose the scope is selection context only and cannot seed formal Memory Leads or Evidence. Seal blind recall before ADC historical self-verification/search.

product_acceptance_shift: Benchmark success is subordinate to researcher understanding. A machine-clean run is a product failure if an industry researcher still has to reconstruct the field structure manually from raw source documents.
stop_rule: Do not add EVT-006/EVT-007 lithium tasks for coverage count. Do not build pharma-specific schema before a real ADC trajectory proves an existing generic primitive cannot express the truth.
